title: WaterColor "Quinnessential Cottage" 22 Winterberry Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor's Crossings District- Features a 2nd living area/den/office- Free WiFi- Low-Speed Vehicle- 4 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This coastal chic beach cottage is the perfect getaway for any vacation and is located in the Crossings District of the WaterColor Community. This home is situated near one of the 5 swimming pools that the WaterColor community offers. The WaterColor community provides a lot of beautiful places to bike and walk. This beautiful home's first level features a king bedroom with flat-screen television and a private bathroom that features a double vanity and a gorgeous walk-in shower. The living area boasts plenty of space while you relax in the cool, beachy hues of the modern decor. The living room area is equipped with a large flat-screen television and a Blue-ray player for movie nights or rainy days indoors. Enjoy a relaxing day at home on the furnished porch while appreciating the beauty of the tranquil community. The open floor concept of this home allows you to enjoy the dining area's simplicity that beautifully compliments the kitchen. The dining area seats 8 guests comfortably, with additional seating at the kitchen island for 4. The second level of the home has 3 bedrooms. The first bedroom on the second level is a primary suite and features a large king bedroom with a private bathroom with a walk-in shower and double vanities. Off the primary suite is the 2nd-floor balcony - a wonderful place to enjoy your morning coffee or evening glass of wine. Right down the hall is the king bedroom with its own private bathroom with a walk-in shower and single vanity. The second floor's last bedroom is a queen bedroom, which has a shared bathroom, featuring a single vanity with a shower and tub combo. This unit also comes with a bonus bunk room on the second floor and a living/den area. This home offers wireless high-speed internet.WATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom One: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom Two: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Twin-over-Twin Built-in Bunk Bed- Living Area: Queen Sleeper *Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
